newsitem.title: TUNISIA: TUNIS BOURSE INDEX CLOSES LITTLE CHANGED.
newsitem.headline: TUNIS BOURSE INDEX CLOSES LITTLE CHANGED.

text.p: The Tunis Stock Exchange index on Friday closed little changed, bourse sources said.
The market's 30-share index closed at 600.28 from 599.88 on Thursday.
Trade volume was almost unchanged at 1.28 million dinars against 1.26 million dinars.
Banque de Tunisie was up 0.9 dinar to 78 dinars. Amen Bank won 0.72 dinar to 58.5 dinars.
Airliner Tunis Air eased 1.17 dinar to 18.08 dinars.
